crossRefs.note: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.
translations.bsb: So Balaam accompanied Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.
translations.kjv: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.
translations.asv: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kiriath-huzoth.
